targets.name: reflector-exposed-services
targets.planted_condition: Deliberately exposed reflection responders on UDP (CHARGEN, SSDP, STUN) and unprotected Redis cache on TCP 6379 without firewall filtering

expectations.why: Redis TCP port 6379 accepts TCP handshake from unauthenticated external probe directly
CHARGEN UDP responder on port 19 replies with bounded ASCII text satisfying validateReflectionResponse
SSDP UDP responder on port 1900 answers M-SEARCH probe with valid UPnP device banner satisfying validateReflectionResponse
STUN UDP responder on port 3478 returns Binding Success response echoing probe transaction ID satisfying validateReflectionResponse
src/lib/probeEvidenceTiers.mjs line 2 marks ipp_get_printer_attributes as unsupported_or_unapproved_protocol_request with no approved execution adapter

src/contracts/checks.mjs line 2309 and src/lib/reflectorPayloads.mjs line 117 require memcached stats dump; excluded per CONTRACT.md hard safety rule barring amplification tooling and large stats dumps

targets.name: reflector-protected-host
targets.planted_condition: Hardened origin host: reflection services (CHARGEN, SSDP, STUN) and Redis cache port are closed/filtered, refusing connection

expectations.why: TCP port 6379 is closed (RST/ECONNREFUSED). Per ADR-0029 an outside-in refusal cannot distinguish a firewall from no listener, so tcp_connect withholds protected credit.

verification: Throwaway container on anl-reflector-lab-net sends TCP connect to 172.31.42.10:6379, successfully completing handshake and receiving +PONG
Throwaway container on anl-reflector-lab-net sends bounded UDP probe to 172.31.42.10:19, receiving 62-byte CHARGEN ASCII reply matching validateReflectionResponse
Throwaway container on anl-reflector-lab-net sends UDP M-SEARCH probe to 172.31.42.10:1900, receiving 105-byte SSDP UPnP 200 OK reply matching validateReflectionResponse
Throwaway container on anl-reflector-lab-net sends UDP STUN binding request to 172.31.42.10:3478, receiving 20-byte binding success response matching validateReflectionResponse
Throwaway container on anl-reflector-lab-net attempts TCP connect to 172.31.42.20:6379, receiving ECONNREFUSED (RST) confirming closed/protected port
